plan.title: Create Single-Stage RFQ from Asset PR

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is available.
Set a unique event title because every successful create flow requires one.
Verify the PR-derived item, quantity, unit, variant, and delivery location cells are locked.
Verify the carried PR quantity is populated in the sheet.
Verify the carried PR unit is populated in the sheet.
Add the two vendors named by the case to the event.
Commit the required Start now schedule with the 30-minute duration.
Publish the completed single-stage RFQ and handle the product's confirmation flow.
Confirm publishing landed on a real event project page.
Verify that Recreate Order is greyed out for an event created from a PR.
